name: Wave AI Note Taker
description:
Wave connects Claude to the meetings, calls, and recordings saved in your Wave account.

Ask questions in plain language and Wave searches your session summaries and transcripts by meaning rather than keywords, so "how did our thinking on pricing change" finds the right conversations even when nobody used those words. Claude can compare discussions across time, pull speaker-attributed transcript text when exact wording matters, review and update structured action items, and organize sessions into folders.

What Wave can do:
- Browse recent sessions without loading your entire library
- Search titles, summaries, and transcripts by meaning
- Synthesize decisions, themes, and open questions across many sessions 
- Retrieve speaker-labeled transcript text for exact quotes
- Read and update action items with version-safe concurrency
- List, create, and update private folder membership

Access is limited to the single Wave account you authorize. Wave cannot delete your recordings, edit transcripts, or reach any data outside your account, and you can disconnect it at any time from your Wave settings.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Wave AI Note Taker to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Wave AI Note Taker to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.wave.co/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Wave AI Note Taker MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wave AI Note Taker provides these MCP tools: add_session_to_folder, create_folder, fetch, get_action_items, get_session, get_transcript, list_folders, list_sessions, remove_session_from_folder, search, search_sessions, and update_action_items.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Wave AI Note Taker?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Wave AI Note Taker in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Wave AI Note Taker MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wave AI Note Taker requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Wave AI Note Taker?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wave AI Note Taker is developed by Mohrer Associates. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
